segments.speaker: mother_aubrine
segments.text: The chapel will take them. But our barley went to the town a month ago. I have nothing to feed them on.

segments.speaker: mother_aubrine
segments.text: You always did find the sharp end of a sermon. Very well. Mercy, then, and in public.

segments.speaker: mother_aubrine
segments.text: Halden. Whatever is in those granaries, these two eat from it tonight, and you'll tell us why it was locked.

segments.speaker: mother_aubrine
segments.text: We killed an old woman over grain you were hoarding against a cold you never told us about. Gods forgive us all. Starting with you.
